reviewer: AI-assisted visual layout review by collate_viii_xii
sourceArtifactDigestProvenance: Supplied by parent agent for the preview source artifact; individual PDF digests computed from inspected files.
scope: Corrected-font preview PDFs with 93/136 Nihaya external comparisons incorporated. This is a rendering sample, not a final edition-content certification.

method.visual: Actual pdftoppm PNG page images opened and inspected; 110 dpi, with selected authorial-note pages at 130 dpi. Text extraction was used to locate samples, not to certify layout.
method.font: pdffonts checked for all nine PDFs; every listed font is embedded, with embedded Unicode-mapped Amiri in every file.
method.readOnly: No PDF, book data, or frozen collation proposal was changed by this layout review.

conclusion: No blocking rendering defect observed in the 42 inspected pages. Arabic joining and diacritics, English text, bilingual authorial notes, glossary headwords, inspected diagrams, and reconstructed English tables are readable and within page margins. Findings F01 and F02 are qualified below.

findings.detail: The preview reports 93/136 comparisons and the early-print bibliography blurb still says IX.9 was compared in full with other selected passages. This is not final 136-unit metadata.
findings.disposition: Parent has added final metadata correction; inspect the rebuilt front matter before final release.

findings.detail: The Arabic table is displayed as an ungrouped right-aligned sequence of headings and formulas across three pages. Text and complement marks are visible and not clipped, but the relationships are hard to consult as a table. The apparatus describes preservation of original ordered columns and distinguishes the English reconstruction.
findings.scope: Pre-existing limitation of the Muzaffar working selection, not a Nihaya completion issue; Muzaffar retains its explicit source and Book VI gaps.
findings.disposition: Recorded; no layout or canonical-text mutation made.

limitations: Only listed pages were visually inspected; unviewed pages are not certified.
The preview PDFs precede the final 136-unit integration. Changed Nihaya sections and final front matter require a separate source-matched sample after rebuild.
Font embedding does not prove textual accuracy; the content collation is documented separately.
No independent human specialist certification, manuscript collation, or full Muzaffar completion is claimed.
